record.question: Who is the author of the book “Hindutva or Hind Swaraj”?
record.explanation: Hindutva or Hind Swaraj is an actual book by U. R. Ananthamurthy, published by Harper Collins in April 2016. The first pass incorrectly treated the title as a conflation of two unrelated books. Historical exam context: 2016-10 (month/year printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://books.google.com/books?id=BydMDQAAQBAJ Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
